title: Guidelines for the documentation of computer based application systems for information processing
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 13394) covers Guidelines for the documentation of computer based application systems for information processing. This Indian Standard which is identical with ISO 6592 : 1985 'information processing — Guidelines for the documentation of computer-based application systems' issued by the Internationa! Organization for Standardization ( ISO ) was adopted by the ( LTD 33 ) and approval of the Electronics and Telecommunication Division Council. In the adopted standard certain terminology and conventions are however not identical to those used in Indian Standards, Attention is particularly drawn to the following: Wherever the words 'International Standard' appear referring to this standard, they should be read as 'Indian Standard', As in the Original Standard, this Page is Intentionally Left Blank IS 13394 ISO 6592 1992 1985
clause_3_terminology: Guidelines for the documentation of computer based application systems for information processing

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
